title: Perplexity Teammates stay on the job. They require Max
friendlyTitle: Perplexity's new agents keep working. You need the Max plan
summary: Perplexity has launched Teammates, agents meant to own ongoing work rather than one Computer session. A teammate can plan a project, watch for changes, pass work to another teammate, and bring a result back for review. Perplexity says each one runs in its own environment, with a browser session separate from the others, and that saved credentials are encrypted. You can review finished work, take over the desktop, or redirect the agent while it is working. Setup is on the web for Max subscribers, with iOS described as coming soon. Free and Pro users are told to upgrade. You name the teammate, connect tools such as Slack, GitHub, or Gmail, and describe where the work comes from and what it should deliver. A teammate can also be added to a Slack channel so colleagues can hand it tasks. The marketing, sales, support, and operations examples on the page are illustrations, not measured results.
